hints: Use a Fenwick tree (BIT) over an auxiliary array eq.
For a type-2 query [2, l, r] the answer is sum(eq[l+1..r]) (count of equal adjacent pairs in the substring).
For a flip [1, j], recompute and update eq[j] and eq[j + 1]; each flip changes at most two eq values.
